H0_same_problem_identity.description: Current environment is still close enough to the upstream benchmark-alignment claim.

H1_embodiment_causal_contract.description: Primary blocker is missing embodiment and causal action semantics, especially orientation-insensitive interaction.

H2_state_representability.description: Primary blocker is unresolved or impossible control-compatible state representability under the current embodiment.

H3_observation_visual_contract.description: Observation contract and visual semantics are a strong co-blocker.

H4_unique_data_scale_only.description: More unique successful data alone can solve the current failure without contract repair.

H5_optimization_only.description: More repeat count or more train steps on the same weak data can solve the current failure.

H6_environment_invalid_for_claim.description: Current environment formulation is insufficient for the benchmark-alignment claim.
